[[Florggi]] is a young female Asura who is friendly with [[Jezza]] but dislikes [[Oggy]].

==Locations==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
**{{NPC location|Alcazia Tangle}} (except when [[A Little Help]] is active)

==Dialogue==
:''"Oggy is such a weirdo. He hits on any two-legged creature wearing a skirt but has no clue how to talk to a lady. We have a word for boys like that where I come from. It's "loser.""''

==Trivia==
Florggi will greet you with [[asura rank|low rank]] [[asura#standard voice responses|Asura responses]], regardless of your actual rank in the Asura title track.
